HashStore — append-only on-chain fingerprint registry for AiCoinTrack.
 Every financial transaction recorded in the MySQL DB gets a keccak256
 fingerprint of its canonical JSON stored here. This makes the off-chain
 record tamper-evident: any mutation changes the hash and the mismatch
 is immediately detectable.
 userId  = the integer primary key from the MySQL users table
 txId    = the integer primary key from the MySQL transactions table
 hash    = keccak256(JSON.stringify(txData, sortedKeys))

Store a single fingerprint.
 Reverts if the exact (txId, hash) pair was already stored
 to prevent accidental double-writes.

Store multiple fingerprints in one transaction (gas-efficient batching).
 Silently skips duplicates so the batch never reverts mid-way.
Return all hashes stored for a user (for audit / frontend display).

Check whether a specific (txId, hash) pair was stored.
 Used by the frontend and backend to verify record integrity.
Return the block timestamp when a hash was stored (0 if not found).
